description: Read a person's recent public posts, FRESH at request time. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Page with `cursor` (pass back the returned cursor) or `start`. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

person_ref.description: The person reference from a profile or search result.
